name: io.github.yarenty/emperor-vikunja
title: Vikunja tasks
description: Vikunja tasks for MCP clients: list and read tasks and projects; with --writable, change them.

packageArguments.description: Speak MCP over stdin and stdout.
Also serve create_task, update_task and comment. Without it the server is read-only (list_tasks, get_task, list_projects).

environmentVariables.name: VIKUNJA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your Vikunja, e.g. https://vikunja.example.com

environmentVariables.name: VIKUNJA_WRITABLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to also serve the write tools (same as --writable); unset, empty or false keeps the server read-only.
